title: Delegate cannot send as manager
symptom: An assistant needs to send emails from a manager's mailbox
user_description: Mr Haroon asked me to send meeting replies from his email while he travels. When I put his address in the From box, Outlook says I don't have permission.

options.why: Never share passwords. Delegated access is given with permissions, not by sharing accounts.

options.text: Forward all the manager's email to her
options.why: She still cannot send as him, and his private mail would go to her inbox.

options.text: Get the manager's approval, then an admin gives her Send As (or Send on Behalf) permission on his mailbox. It can take a little while to start working
options.why: These permissions let a delegate send from the manager's address safely, and they can be removed later.

options.text: Make her an admin so she can do it herself
options.why: Admin rights are far more than she needs and a security risk.

hints: Who needs to agree before anyone sends as the manager?
Is there a permission made for this?
Why not just share his password?
real_world_tip: Send As makes the email look like it came from the manager. Send on Behalf shows 'Saima on behalf of Haroon'. Ask the manager which he prefers.
